noah: ok this week is wild i accepted a promo and moving into a new apartment on Saturday!!! :tada: :houses:
izzy: TWO HUGE life events. congrats!!! when do we celebrate?
sam: We need a mini celebration. Lunch or after-work? quick poll: :cake: for lunch, :beer: after-work.
rachel: lunch is easiest. i can bring a savory platter and a dairy-free cake option (no nuts).
noah: thanks rachel. allergy note: i'm allergic to cashews but otherwise fine. appreciate the cake thought.
people-ops-bot: Promo logged: Noah promoted to Senior Backend Engineer. Swag tier unlocked and $125 celebratory budget available.
izzy: also thinking a tiny housewarming: a small plant + keychain. who wants to chip in?
sam: i can chip in. @people-ops-bot can swag credit be used for a gift instead?
people-ops-bot: Yes. Organizer may reallocate swag funds to a small gift. Please confirm via DM.
kitchen-bot: Kitchen island reserved Thu 12:15-12:30 for "Noah mini-celebration".
rachel: I'll order nut-free, dairy-free vanilla sheet cake and bring savory bites. sam, can you grab candles?
sam: on it. also remote folks can drop quick 15s clips in this thread and i'll compile.
noah: youlre all the best. super grateful. moving boxes are chaotic but excited.
